summary: Opt in, activate and edit a generated diagnostic groom, then restore the normal hairstyle without changing V.

steps.does: Derive section-coloured clump envelopes and material coordinates.
Generate layered ribbons from volumes and shade with the native atlas and character colour profile.
Persist opt-in; conditionally load experiment registrations.
Resolve preference and isolated verification override.
Ask the platform to maintain the explicitly enabled experiment contribution.
Load and register the optional module with an abortable lifetime.
Activate the groom and scene session.
Ask for the session revision to be visible.
Demand matching geometry and own generation and renderer lifetimes.
Supply geometry references for the bound character revision.
Validate maps and graph and derive stable attached root samples.
Refine in the worker and publish only the matching complete revision.
Attach diagnostic geometry and replace only the resolved hair slot.
Append independent groom edits, supersede old work and retain Undo.
On deactivation abort work, withdraw replacement and restore normal hair.

demand: The person activates Hair Lab in a visible module with a bound character scene; no feature demand or imports while its flag is off.

faults.when: A graph, field unit, coordinate transform or value is invalid.
The character geometry does not provide usable scalp support.
Worker or renderer failed; normal hair remains and Try again is offered.

latency: Input feedback in the same cycle; coarse generation at most 8 ms and warm action-to-frame at most 50 ms.
Warm refined action-to-frame target 500 ms; measure preparation, queue, solve, upload and first draw separately.
No page task over 50 ms; check cancellation between bounded worker batches.
budget.memory: Incremental CPU buffers at most 128 MiB and diagnostic GPU buffers at most 16 MiB; tests under a 6 GB guard.

invariants: Flag off imports no lab modules and registers no lab menus, panels, renderers or workers.
Neither lab settings nor groom edits modify character/save data or an existing draft.
Stable follicle identities and attachments are independent of preview density.
Branches partition; convergence unions disjoint sets; termination accounts for ended identities.
Map transport preserves identity, original length coordinates, units and phase.
Every attached result matches groom, scene, character, revision and geometry identity.
Deactivation, hiding the module, disabling the flag, abort or failure restores normal resolved hair.
Generation is deterministic for equal inputs and cancellation cannot publish a stale revision.
Two sessions in different scenes cannot change each other or share implicit current state.
